text: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Human Experience During clinical trials of RELISTOR administered subcutaneously, no cases of methylnaltrexone bromide overdose were reported. In a study of healthy volunteers (n = 41), a single dose of 0.50 mg/kg administered as a subcutaneous injection was well-tolerated. A study of healthy volunteers noted orthostatic hypotension associated with a dose of 0.64 mg/kg administered as an IV bolus. 10.2 Management of Overdosage No specific information is available on the treatment of overdose with RELISTOR. In the event of overdose, employ the usual supportive measures, e.g., clinical monitoring and supportive therapy as dictated by the patient's clinical status. Signs or symptoms of orthostatic hypotension should be monitored, and treatment should be initiated, as appropriate.
